name: ai-novelflow
description: NovelFlow 是一个将小说自动转换为视频的 AI 平台。文生图、图生图、图生视频都是基于开源模型及B站大佬分享的工作流。（NovelFlow is an AI platform that automatically converts novels into videos. Text-to-image, image-to-image, and image-to-video generation are all powered by open-source models and workflow templates shared by creators on Bilibili.）
